notes: 1.50.10: Tiêu chuẩn bậc screen no longer dead-ends for the 21 frameworks seeded in 1.50.9 with no grade definitions. Admin can now add grades one at a time ('+ Thêm bậc', name prompted, never auto-generated) for a version with none yet, then fill in the item×grade matrix and save through the existing knl_save_grade_matrix RPC — no new backend, no migration. Sales and the 10 pre-existing 5-level frameworks are untouched (still read straight from backend grade definitions). Competency level counts stay exactly as sourced (Sales 4, most Excel sources 5, Trưởng Kho (PHF) legacy 4 vs v2 5) — never derived from grade count or vice versa.
